source.author: verg
source.text: terna tibi haec primum triplici diversa colore licia circumdo, terque haec altaria circum effigiem duco: numero deus impare gaudet.
source.text_original: terna tibi haec primum triplici diversa colore / licia circumdo, terque haec altaria circum / effigiem duco: numero deus impare gaudet.
source.text_english: First I wind these three threads around you, varied in triple color, and three times I lead these about the altar, around your image: the god delights in an odd number.

reuse.author: hier
reuse.text_english: God delights in an odd number.
